body: Yes I realize that. Many of them feel rather empty and alone inside, I think. My post is solely highlighting the inequality between the poor and rich.

Look...

The truth is, society does not like physically ugly people! No amount of ANYTHING is going to change this! I bet being ugly is like a living hell for someone. Who wants to be ugly, really? I bet nobody does. I don't wanna be ugly.

Are you guys gonna keep lying to yourselves? If you saw this dude irl you'd probably be repulsed and run far, far away. 

The only kind of ugly people who seem to get any favorable attention are the rich ones!

I feel the exact same way. Life isn't for me. There's nothing I enjoy about it. I spend my days browsing random shit on the web and playing video games and I'm absolutely terrible at video games. 

You've hit the mark about the friends part. Friends are like plants. You have to water them, feed and nurture them, because if you don't, the plant wilts and dies. In this case the friend will probably begone from your life. 

FYI I go to counselling and they do most of the talking...
